mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive despite GDPC1 increasing by >5% from prior quarter, or returns negative in expansionary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers monetary tightening, compressing discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns positive when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high demand (GDPC1) and strong supply (INDPRO) jointly signal robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not positive despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 7.0% triggers labor market strengthening, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns negative when UNRATE falls below 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals tight monetary policy, leading to compressed equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns positive when CPIAUCSL increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) combined with strong GDP growth (GDPC1) signal accommodative policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, a decline in the federal funds rate strengthens equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive in late-cycle periods despite FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'post-shock recovery' regime, a drop in RSAFS demand signals improved economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns negative when RSAFS decreases in post-shock regime.
